facts.value: Students enrolled in other departments can complete certain modules at the Department of Economics, known as export modules, including optional modules.
This is only possible based on existing cooperation agreements between departments.

An overview is provided outlining which export modules from the Department of Economics can be registered by students from other departments and how these modules can be integrated into their studies.
Students may not integrate other modules from the Department of Economics into their studies in another department and may not acquire differing Credit Points (CP) at the Department of Economics.
